name: 07_seal_food_box
title: Seal and Inspect Food Box
summary: The robot seals a food box with a plastic lid, checks utensils on the right, and returns to unseal the container.
robot: two black dexterous hands with white robotic arms
setting: a dining table with a green tablecloth, wooden chairs, a stack of bowls, and utensil holders

source.original_prompt: Press the box lid with both hands to seal the box

segments.instruction: Pick up the clear plastic lid from the bottom left with both hands.
Place the lid onto the food box in the center and press down firmly with both hands to seal it.
segments.memory_event: hide: the contents inside the food container are covered by the sealed lid

segments.instruction: Turn the head camera to the right toward the chopstick holder and reach for a wooden chopstick with the right hand.
segments.memory_event: hide: the sealed food box and left table area leave the camera view as the head turns right

segments.instruction: Lift the chopstick and gently tap the rim of the stacked beige bowls.
Place the chopstick back into the light-blue holder and retract the right hand.
Turn the head camera back to the center of the table toward the food container.
segments.memory_event: return: the sealed food container reappears in the center of the table exactly as left

segments.instruction: Grasp the edges of the lid with both hands and remove it, setting it down on the table to the left.
segments.memory_event: return: the coiled food contents inside the container are exposed again, looking identical to the start

segments.instruction: Nudge the open food container slightly forward with the left hand and return both hands to rest.
